message.content: It’s hard to pin down a single “best” film from 2020 because tastes vary so much, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** as the standout of that year. Though released in late 2019, its impact carried strongly into 2020—winning the Academy Award for Best Picture, sweeping major awards, and sparking worldwide discussions about class, storytelling, and cinema itself. If you’re looking for a film that defined 2020 for many people, “Parasite” is the one to watch.
